# Appicta

> Appicta is a mobile app that turns any PDF into a live, on-the-spot inspection
> record. Import a plan, drop numbered markers, attach photos and voice notes,
> sketch to scale, and export a client-ready PDF and photo report in one tap —
> on site, before you leave. Designed and built in Switzerland. Coming soon to
> the Apple App Store and Google Play (iOS and Android).

## What it does
- Annotate any PDF (floor plan, site map, vehicle diagram, survey form) with numbered markers — no redrawing, no second app.
- Attach a photo and a voice note to each marker; type it up later if preferred.
- Sketch markup that scales and pans with the plan, so it stays true to scale instead of drifting when you zoom.
- Export an annotated PDF, a photo appendix, and every original photo and voice memo in one tap.

## Who it is for
- Property and real estate walkthroughs
- Vehicle and fleet inspections
- Environmental and ecological surveys
- Facilities and maintenance rounds
- Construction and site visits

## Key facts
- Platforms: iOS and Android (coming soon)
- Origin: Designed and built in Switzerland
- Made by: Tobias Filiberti (Developer) and David Filiberti (Developer)
